_provenance: Tracked EXAMPLE of the gitignored host companion settings.local.json: copy this file to settings.local.json beside it, fill in the real paths, and never track the copy (tracked files stay free of usernames and machine paths). deploy-to-host.ps1 / deploy-to-host.sh deep-merge the companion into the deployed settings.json (objects key by key, arrays concatenated without duplicates, companion scalars win); the tracked settings.json stays clean and the launcher's --setting-sources user makes the deployed file the only settings a session reads. The path values use the double-backslash form because JSON escapes backslashes, so a doubled backslash is the one literal separator once parsed; the deploy's deep-merge preserves each value into the deployed settings.json exactly as written. The third additionalDirectories entry (C:\Users\<your-username>\AppData\Local\Temp\claude) is the harness's per-session scratchpad root, so members write there without asking (whether a dispatched subagent inherits additionalDirectories from the parent session is unchecked). Where the harness advertises that scratchpad in 8.3 short form (a <your-username>~1 segment, e.g. C:\Users\<SHORT~1>\AppData\Local\Temp\claude), add that short-form root as an additional entry too. On a Linux host the scratchpad root carries a per-uid segment, so the third entry is /tmp/claude-<uid> — the uid segment is inferred from the Windows form, not verified against the harness docs. On macOS it is the TMPDIR-based form ${TMPDIR}/claude-<uid>, unlived (no macOS host has run this).
